$comment: Descriptive, derived from the types the bounded parser reads; the parser is the only authority on validity. Where the parser reads two versions of a document with one type, this schema admits what that type admits, including members the later version adds. Byte, depth and count bounds are recorded in x-rustev-parse-limits (a string length here counts characters, the parser counts bytes), and rules applied when a plan is compiled are stated in field descriptions, not enforced here.

BundleVariant.description:
The variant a bundle is instantiated for (3.3.8): `{"named": <name>}`,
the name matching `[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,63}` (034 3.1.3). The variant `none`
is spelled by omitting the member.

CompileReport.description:
Successful output of the existing surface compile command. Output paths
are report observations; they never become an endpoint in a binding.

Embedded_rustev_calibration_1.description: An embedded `rustev.calibration/1` document, carried as its original bytes and checked by that document's own bounded parser.

Embedded_rustev_definition_1.description: An embedded `rustev.definition/1` document, carried as its original bytes and checked by that document's own bounded parser.

Embedded_rustev_execution_1.description: An embedded `rustev.execution/1` document, carried as its original bytes and checked by that document's own bounded parser.

Embedded_rustev_profile_1.description: An embedded `rustev.profile/1` document, carried as its original bytes and checked by that document's own bounded parser.

Text_1_4096.description: Length is enforced in decoded UTF-8 bytes by the parser.

profile.description:
The tenant profile, the leaf of the chain (spec 034); omitted for
none, so a bundle without one keeps its bytes (3.3.8).

profile_bases.description:
1 to 64 profiles available to the leaf's `extends` chain; omitted
for none, and only with a profile.

variant.description: The variant the bundle is instantiated for; omitted for `none`.
